description:
Recto: Accounting of the Qodesh or possibly a court register in the hand of Yefet b. David b. Shekhanya. Mentions [...] ha-Parnas b. Mevasser. Very faded, uncited in the literature. 

Verso: Probably a related text in Arabic script, may be also in his hand. The fragment resembles Bodl. MS heb. b 11/5 (PGPID 4414) with Judaeo-Arabic on one side and Arabic on the other, but the layouts are different and they do not appear to be a direct join.
description_he: רשימה או טבלה בArabic, Judaeo-Arabic. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
